title: Weave, a YC W25 Startup, Opens Engineering Roles Across ML, AI, Product and Design
dek: The young company is recruiting across technical and product disciplines, signaling an early effort to build both its AI capabilities and the product teams around them.
socialCaption: YC W25 startup Weave is hiring across ML, AI, product and design engineering. The cross-functional search is a reminder that AI product teams need more than model specialists: they also need the people who can ship, shape and refine the software around them.
